capabilities: Render journal transactions as a sortable, filterable table
Show as-of-aware account balances and hierarchical category shares
Triage :tbc: transactions with one-click account assignment
Manage categorizer rules with live match counter and conflict check
Rebuild the journal from CSVs inside the plugin
disambiguation: Not a budgeting or expense-tracking app; it reads and triages an hledger journal that already exists in the vault.
extras: Full documentation lives in docs/ (getting started, troubleshooting, design system); the mobile file picker has not been tested on a physical device; the plugin id was renamed from finance to finance-ledger on 2026-06-10.
problem: An hledger journal in a vault is plain text, so there is no way inside Obsidian to browse transactions, check balances, see category shares or sort out uncategorized entries.

relations.evidence: The Python importer is no longer needed for anything.
renders hledger journals as filterable tables with balance and category dashboards

summary: Renders hledger journals as filterable transaction tables with balance, category and dashboard views, plus TBC triage and rule management.
